up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules reported in document CHEMBL1821550. Filter the docs table where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1821550'. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Return only molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Apply DISTINCT to the final projection.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1821550'
